# ADR-3109: A10: User-controlled URL fetch for connector 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

SSRF reaches internal and cloud metadata targets.

## Decision

Services MUST NOT perform a user-controlled URL fetch for connector 1 (A10-1).

## Consequences

Allow-listed hosts and schemes are enforced.
